gloss: to boil up; to seethe; to surge with excitement

definitions.gloss: to boil up; to bubble vigorously; to seethe
definitions.explanation: For a liquid to boil intensely, with steam or bubbles rising energetically.

definitions.gloss: to surge with excitement; to be in an uproar; to be buzzing
definitions.explanation: For a place or group of people to become filled with excitement, enthusiasm, or agitation. Describes a lively, energetic atmosphere.

examples.english: The soup in the pot is bubbling vigorously.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧ (to boil, to well up) and ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to rise), giving a vivid image of steam or energy rising. The figurative sense (sense 2) is very common in sports and entertainment contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: the venue erupts
- ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: the audience buzzes with excitement
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: anger surges up
- ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{沸|わ}き{立|た}つ: to buzz with anticipation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧: to boil; to get excited — simpler and more common, less dramatic
- ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧: to get fired up — focuses on building excitement, especially at events
- ⟦{沸騰|ふっとう}する→沸騰する：21985_futtousuru⟧: to boil — more technical/literal for boiling; figuratively means public opinion reaching a boiling point
